title: Tumble and the Sneezy Sunflower Seed
moral: If something doesn't work, try again, and you will grow too!
description: Tumble the elephant gets a teeny-tiny sunflower seed from Nana Hoot, but a giant sneeze and a very big drink of water get in the way! Join Pip, Hazel and Tumble to learn what a seed needs to grow and how roots, sprouts, leaves and flowers appear.
intro: Hi friends! Welcome to Little Lantern Stories! Today's story is... Tumble and the Sneezy Sunflower Seed! Get ready to grow something!

narration.text: Hi! Guess what? One sunny morning, Nana Hoot had a surprise for Tumble the elephant. A teeny-tiny SEED!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo! This is a sunflower seed, Tumble. Plant it, and it will grow into something wonderful.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Ooh! Will it grow into a rocket? A rocket-flower? Super-duper!
Hee-hee! Not a rocket, Pip. A seed grows into a PLANT!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Nana, what does a seed need to grow?

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Ooh, I know, I know! Cookies! Seeds LOVE cookies!
Hee-hee-hee! No, Pip! Seeds don't eat cookies, silly!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: A seed needs three things. Soil to snuggle in. Water to drink. And warm, golden sunshine!
Then Nana's glasses slid riiiight down her beak. Wheee... boop!
Tumble dug a little hole in the soil. He held the seed up high. And then... a fluffy dandelion tickled his trunk.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Ah... ah... AH-CHOOOOO!
Whoooosh! The seed flew up, up, up... and BONK! It landed right on Pip's nose!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Ow-ee! I found the seed! Try number one... oopsie!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oopsie-trunk! Sorry, Pip. Let's try again!
Tumble planted the seed in the soil. Pat, pat, pat! Now it needed some WATER.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: I'll give it a big, BIG drink!
He filled up his trunk and... SPLOOOOSH! So much water! The garden turned into a muddy puddle!
Pip went slippy-slidey... wheeee! And the little seed floated away, like a tiny boat.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oh no. Try number two didn't work either. Maybe I just can't grow anything.

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Tee-hee-hee! Don't give up, Tumble! Let's try one more time... together!
So Pip fished out the seed. Tumble pressed it gently into the soft soil. Then Hazel showed him how to water... just a little.
Let's count the sprinkles! One... two... three!
Now, friends, can you remember? What three things does a seed need?
Soil, water and sunshine! Yay! You're so clever!
That night, everyone waited and waited. Nana Hoot waited so long, she started to snooze. Zzzzz...
But guess what? Under the soil, the seed was waking up! It pushed out tiny little ROOTS.
Which way do roots grow? Up, or down?
DOWN! Down, down, down, to sip the water in the soil. You got it!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Nana! Nana! Is it growing yet?

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo... zzz... I'm awake! I'm awake!

popups.sub: the stem grows UP to the sun

narration.text: The next morning, the sun came up, warm and golden. And then... POP! A little green SPROUT!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: BOING! Ooh, my prickles! It's a sprout! Tee-hee-hee!
The sprout grows UP, up, up, towards the sunshine. How many leaves can YOU count?
Two little leaves! Hooray! Great counting!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK HONK! Our seed is really growing!
Every day, they gave it a little water and lots of sunshine. The stem grew taller... and taller... and TALLER!
Until one day... a giant yellow FLOWER opened up, smiling at the sun!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! It's even taller than me!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: It's a sun-flower-tower-power-shower! Super-duper!
Hee-hee! It's a SUNFLOWER, Pip!

popups.sub: what a seed needs to grow

narration.text: Let's remember! What does a seed need to grow?
Soil, water and sunshine! Woo-hoo!
And what grows first, under the soil? The roots, or the flower?
The roots! Then the sprout, then the leaves, and then... the flower! You're plant experts!
Soon the big sunflower had lots and lots of brand-new seeds. And then... Tumble's trunk began to tickle.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Ah... ah... AH-CHOOOOO!
Whoooosh! The seeds flew everywhere... and landed plop, plop, plop, right in a row of flower pots! Let's count them. One, two, three, four, five!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! You tried, and tried, and tried again, Tumble. And look what grew!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Now everyone can grow a sunflower! Oopsie-trunk... I mean, super-duper!
